goal: Look up member 12345 and read their current savings balance

capability.name: Read member savings balance
capability.description: Looks up a credit union member by numeric member ID and returns their savings account balance, savings account number, member name and status from the member detail screen. Returns MEMBER_NOT_FOUND if no member matches the identifier.

inputs.name: member_id
inputs.description: Numeric member identifier; partial matches are not supported.

outputs.name: savings_balance
outputs.description: Current savings account balance for the member.

outputs.name: savings_account_number
outputs.description: Savings account number for the member.

outputs.name: member_name
outputs.description: Member's name as shown on the detail screen.

outputs.name: status
outputs.description: Member account status flag, e.g. active.

summary: Recorded a capability that searches for a member by numeric ID from the Member Lookup form, opens the matching result's detail record, and extracts the savings balance, savings account number, member name and status. A MEMBER_NOT_FOUND outcome is declared for the "No member found" search-results screen.
